subject: Optimize toolkit: pilot credits, packaging & quantization phasing
messages:
From: Alec Turner <alec.turner@greenbridge.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@greenbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on Optimize credits + quant plan

Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our model team is excited by the batching/cache recommendations you showed. Two quick asks as we scope internally: 1) what's a small pilot packaging that lets us evaluate batching+KV caching impact on token costs, and 2) what quantization profiles do you recommend we try first (we run a mix of 7B and 13B LLM variants)?

We want to run a 4-week trial against ~10M tokens/day to measure both latency and NLL drift. Also need a ballpark on commercial structure: credits vs short-term commit vs PoC waiver. Procurement might be involved if there's a credit/commit ask.

Can you share a suggested pilot outline and any caveats on quality tradeoffs?

—Alec
Alec Turner, Head of AI Eng
GreenBridge AI

Attachments: greenbridge_eval_set.csv (sample eval prompts)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alec Turner <alec.turner@greenbridge.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@greenbridge.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick question on Optimize credits + quant plan

Alec —

Really appreciate the clear asks and sample eval set. Quick summary below and I attached a one‑page reference and a pilot term sheet to make procurement easier. High level proposal:

- Pilot scope (60 days): 50k USD credits applied to Optimize toolkit recommendations + hosted tokens. Enough to cover your 10M/day estimate for 2–3 weeks of full load and the remainder for follow-up tests.
- Technical phasing: start with batching + KV cache + int8 quantization for the 7B models. Run a parallel int4A/B experiment on a small slice (10%) of traffic for quality checks. For 13B, we recommend int8 as default; int4 is higher risk for hallucination unless we do prompt-level calibration.
- Metrics & gating: measure per-request latency P95, token cost per 1k, and NLL + a small hand-labeled quality set from your evals. If degradation > 3% on quality signals, we pull back quantization on that model.
- Commercials: pilot credits (non‑refundable) + option to convert to a 12‑month commit for a 12–18% committed discount on token list price depending on commit band. If you sign for Dedicated capacity within 6 months we can negotiate an early-conversion credit.

I'll loop in Dylan to confirm the credit math and Connor for rollout ops. Attached: Optimize_Quick_Reference.pdf and RBW-4821_pilot_term_sheet.pdf.

Next step: are you ok with the 60-day/50k pilot and the gating thresholds above? If procurement needs a contract redline we can provide a short SOW.

—Kimberly Park
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Optimize_Quick_Reference.pdf; RBW-4821_pilot_term_sheet.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick question on Optimize credits + quant plan

Thanks — a few concrete items from engineering/ops to nail down for the term sheet and pricing:

- Credit sizing: 50k USD looks reasonable as a starting pilot. We should explicitly call out token vs optimize-toolkit credit split (e.g., 35k for hosted tokens / 15k for Optimize recommendations and tooling).
- Discounting: propose standard pilot->commit path: 50% of pilot value applied as a one-time conversion credit if they convert to a 12-month commit >= $150k ARR within 90 days of pilot end. That avoids us over-indexing credits up-front.
- Technical guardrails: need to include a clause that int4 runs are experimental and that we reserve the right to throttle if QoE regression is observed. Also include a short checklist for their infra (latency targets, TLS/KMS requirements) for Private/Dedicated conversion readiness.
- Ops runbook: Connor can own rollout; we recommend a mirror traffic test (10% shadow) for int4 experiments before any live routing.

Connor — can you confirm lead time for a shadow rollout and any extra instrumentation costs?

—Dylan

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick question on Optimize credits + quant plan

Lead time: 10 business days to prepare a safe shadow rollout environment if GreenBridge grants us access to a limited production mirror (or we can run in-hosted shadow with a rate cap). Instrumentation: basic telemetry is included in the pilot (latency/cost/NLL). If they want per-token A/B logging and label management we add a one-time setup fee (typically $5k) to manage the eval uploads and scoring pipeline.

I'll draft the rollout runbook and a short acceptance checklist for the term sheet. Agree with the 50/35k split on credits to make procurement accounting simple.

—Connor
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Maya Patel <maya@greenbridge.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alec Turner <alec.turner@greenbridge.ai>, procurement@greenbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick question on Optimize credits + quant plan

Kimberly/Dylan/Connor —

Thanks for the clear proposal and the attachments. GreenBridge is comfortable with the 60-day pilot and the suggested gating metrics. A couple of procurement asks before we sign: 1) can you add the conversion-credit language to the term sheet (so procurement sees the path to apply 50% of pilot value to a future commit), and 2) clarify that the int4 runs are opt-in and require GreenBridge signoff before we flip anything live.

Also, procurement would like a short SOW summarizing deliverables (rollout runbook, eval scoring, 2 workshops with your team). We can provide a standard PO template once we have that SOW and the pilot term sheet updated.

If you can get an updated packet by EOD Wed 9 Jun we can route internally and aim to start the pilot by Jun 21.

—Maya Patel
Director of Product Ops, GreenBridge AI

Attachments: (none)
